digest.component_or_area: LLM model class configuration and resolution
propositions: Rebar lacks a mechanism to specify different LLM models for different capability tiers (frontier, standard, trivial), forcing all per-pass decisions to be inferred from a single scalar config value.

A new config schema must define three class slots (frontier, standard, trivial) accepting model, provider, endpoint, and an optional fallback array, parsed from the existing layered config precedence (CLI > env > file > default).

The resolver must map class names to provider-qualified model strings, reusing infer_provider when provider is omitted, and preserve bit-for-bit backward compatibility when nothing is configured (frontier→claude-opus-4-8, standard→claude-sonnet-4-6, trivial→claude-haiku-4-5).

Fallback entries must be non-recursive provider targets with model (required), provider (optional), and endpoint (optional), with api_key forbidden at both slot and entry level to maintain the secrets-env-only boundary.
The entry point load_class_slots() must read the model_classes sub-table from the merged [tool.rebar.llm] config and return resolved slots, making the schema reachable from real configuration.
